notes: 8 configurations from 5 manufacturers (Quantum Design Oxford, Bluefors including its Cryomech liquefier line, Linde Kryotechnik, Cryofab, AS Scientific under ILL licence), all accessed 2026-11-01. Tavily quota was exhausted, so pages and PDFs were read directly (curl + pdftotext). Absences cite complete specification sheets or scope-of-supply lists as the scope-defining quote. Commercial SRF vertical test cryostats, cryomodules, magnet test benches, polarized-target refrigerators and LAr TPC cryostats are not included: no public manufacturer specifications were found (they are bespoke facility builds, already represented in the catalog by FNAL VTS, SULTAN, ITER MCTF and WARP). The Cryofab dewar temperature (4.2 K) is reference data from NIST NCNR about helium vented to atmosphere, not a Cryofab figure. Linde marks its 4.4 K figures as expected performance.
